unmapped_findings: The solid solution has been formed after 25 h of milling; the phases formed are BCC (a = 0.286 nm; JCPDS# 00-006-0696) and γ-brass type (a = 0.872 nm; JCPDS# 01-078-2831). Milling was extended to 35 h for further nanostructuring (b0038).

Alloying with milling time is related to diffusion of low-melting-point elements into the matrix of higher-melting-point elements; Al has the highest alloying rate (its XRD intensity diminishes after 15 h), and after 20 h the intense Ni and Mn peaks are no longer evident (b0038).
The crystallite size of Si decreased from 20 nm (25 h) to 14 nm (35 h) as milling extended (b0040).
The lattice parameter of the major BCC phase formed during milling is close to ferritic iron (α-Fe) acting as the host lattice (b0058).
